questions.q: My sister is good ___ solving problems, so she wants to be an engineer.
questions.explain: "be good at" kalıbı bir konuda iyi olmayı anlatır.

questions.q: I'm interested ___ working with animals, so I'd like to be a vet.
questions.explain: "be interested in + V-ing" bir şeye ilgi duymayı anlatır.

questions.q: A person who designs buildings is called an ___.
questions.explain: Mimar binaları tasarlar; accountant muhasebeci, astronaut astronottur.

questions.q: A ___ works in a hospital and helps doctors take care of patients.
questions.explain: Hemşire (nurse) hastanede hastalarla ilgilenir.

questions.q: She ___ speak three languages fluently, so she can become a translator.
questions.explain: Yetenek anlatmak için "can" kullanılır.

questions.q: In the future, robots ___ do many dangerous jobs instead of people.
questions.explain: Gelecekteki yetenek "will be able to" ile ifade edilir.

questions.q: Choose the best answer: "Why do you want to be a software developer?"
choices: Because I'm keen on coding and creating apps.
questions.explain: "Why" sorusuna "Because" ile neden belirten bir cevap verilir; "be keen on" bir şeye hevesli olmak demektir.

questions.q: I ___ the guitar for three years. I started when I was fourteen.
questions.explain: Geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren eylemler için Present Perfect (have + V3) ve "for" kullanılır.

questions.q: She has been interested in photography ___ 2022.
questions.explain: Başlangıç zamanı "since" ile, süre "for" ile belirtilir.

questions.q: Have you ever ___ a horse?
questions.explain: "Have you ever" sorusunda fiilin üçüncü hâli (V3) kullanılır: ride-rode-ridden.

questions.q: My brother enjoys ___ model airplanes in his free time.
questions.explain: "enjoy" fiilinden sonra fiil -ing alır.

questions.q: Which hobby needs patience and a needle?
questions.explain: Örgü örmek (knitting) sabır ve şiş/iğne gerektirir.

questions.q: A: "How long have you been learning chess?" B: "___"
questions.explain: "How long" süre sorar; "for + süre" ile cevap verilir.

questions.q: I have never ___ bungee jumping. It looks scary!
questions.explain: "have never + V3" hiç yapmadığımız şeyleri anlatır.

questions.q: When I was a child, I ___ play in the street with my friends every evening.
questions.explain: Geçmişteki alışkanlıklar "used to + V1" ile anlatılır.

questions.q: People didn't ___ have electricity in most villages a hundred years ago.
questions.explain: Olumsuz ve soru cümlelerinde "didn't use to" yazılır.

questions.q: I ___ my homework when the lights went out.
questions.explain: Geçmişte devam eden bir eylem başka bir eylemle kesildiğinde Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) kullanılır.

questions.q: During the war, many families ___ to leave their homes.
questions.explain: Geçmişteki zorunluluk "had to" ile anlatılır.

questions.q: A period in which there is not enough food for many people is called a ___.
questions.explain: Famine kıtlık demektir; harvest hasat anlamına gelir.

questions.q: While they ___ across the bridge, the earthquake started.
questions.explain: "While" genellikle devam eden eylemle (Past Continuous) kullanılır.

questions.q: Write about how life was different for your grandparents. Use "used to" and "didn't use to" in at least three sentences.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: My grandparents used to live in a small village. They didn't use to have a television, so they used to listen to the radio in the evenings. My grandfather used to walk to school for an hour every day. They didn't use to buy bread; my grandmother used to bake it at home.

questions.q: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ___.
questions.explain: Geçmişteki bir olaydan daha önce olmuş eylemler Past Perfect (had + V3) ile anlatılır.

questions.q: She ___ never seen the sea before she moved to Ordu.
questions.explain: Taşınmadan önceki durumu anlatmak için "had never seen" kullanılır.

questions.q: After he ___ university, he started working as a journalist.
questions.explain: İki geçmiş eylemden önce olanı Past Perfect ile, sonra olanı Past Simple ile yazılır.

questions.q: Which word best completes the biography? "Marie Curie was the first woman ___ won a Nobel Prize."
questions.explain: İnsanlardan söz eden sıfat cümlelerinde "who" kullanılır.

questions.q: A book that someone writes about their own life is called an ___.
questions.explain: Autobiography otobiyografi demektir; başkasının hayatını anlatan kitap biography'dir.

questions.q: Choose the correct order: "Aziz Sancar / in 2015 / the Nobel Prize in Chemistry / won"
choices: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry won Aziz Sancar in 2015.
In 2015 won Aziz Sancar the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
Won Aziz Sancar in 2015 the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
Aziz Sancar won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015.
Aziz Sancar in 2015 the Nobel Prize won in Chemistry.
questions.explain: İngilizcede temel sıra: özne + fiil + nesne + zaman.

questions.q: When I got to the station, I realised I ___ my ticket at home.
questions.explain: Bileti evde bırakma eylemi istasyona varmadan önce olmuştur; Past Perfect kullanılır.

questions.q: Hagia Sophia ___ in the 6th century.
questions.explain: Eylemi kimin yaptığı değil, eylemin kendisi önemliyse edilgen yapı (was/were + V3) kullanılır.

questions.q: The ancient city of Troy ___ by archaeologists in the 19th century.
questions.explain: Şehir keşfetmez, keşfedilir; bu yüzden edilgen yapı gerekir.

questions.q: Göbeklitepe is believed to be about 12,000 years ___.
questions.explain: Bir şeyin yaşını belirtmek için "years old" kullanılır.

questions.q: A place where old and valuable objects are kept and shown to the public is a ___.
questions.explain: Museum müze demektir.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive form: "They opened the museum in 1935."
choices: The museum is opened in 1935 by they.
They were opened the museum in 1935.
questions.explain: Nesne başa gelir, fiil "was + V3" olur.

questions.q: Many old coins ___ during the excavation last summer.
questions.explain: Özne çoğul olduğu için "were + V3" kullanılır.

questions.q: Write three sentences about a historical place in Turkey using the passive voice.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: The Süleymaniye Mosque was designed by Mimar Sinan. It was built in the 16th century. Today it is visited by thousands of tourists every year.

questions.q: A: "I feel stressed before exams." B: "You ___ get enough sleep and take short breaks."
questions.explain: Tavsiye vermek için "should" kullanılır.

questions.q: If I were you, I ___ talk to my teacher about the problem.
questions.explain: "If I were you, I would..." kalıbı tavsiye vermek için kullanılır.

questions.q: Which word describes someone who feels sad because they are alone?
questions.explain: Lonely yalnız ve bu yüzden üzgün hisseden kişiyi anlatır.

questions.q: A: "My best friend is angry with me." B: "Why don't you ___ to her?"
questions.explain: "Why don't you + V1?" öneri kalıbıdır.

questions.q: Choose the most polite request.
choices: Could you help me with this, please?
questions.explain: "Could you ..., please?" kibar rica kalıbıdır.

questions.q: You had better ___ your parents where you are going.
questions.explain: "had better" kalıbından sonra fiil yalın hâlde (V1) gelir.

questions.q: Your friend feels nervous about a school presentation. Write a short message giving at least three pieces of advice.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: Don't worry, you'll be great! You should practise in front of a mirror or your family. If I were you, I would prepare small note cards. You'd better get a good night's sleep before the presentation. Take a deep breath and speak slowly.

questions.q: The first Bosphorus Bridge ___ in 1973.
questions.explain: Köprü kendisi inşa etmez, inşa edilir; geçmişte olduğu için edilgen geçmiş zaman (was + V3) kullanılır.

questions.q: Cappadocia ___ for its fairy chimneys and hot-air balloons.
questions.explain: "be known for" bir şeyle tanınmak demektir.

questions.q: Turkish coffee ___ to UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2013.
questions.explain: Kahve listeye eklenir; edilgen yapı (was + V3) kullanılır.

questions.q: Hazelnuts ___ mainly in the Black Sea region, especially in Ordu and Giresun.
questions.explain: Fındık yetiştirilir; çoğul özne için "are + V3" kullanılır.

questions.q: Ankara ___ the capital city of Turkey in 1923.
questions.explain: Geçmişte belirli bir yılda olan olay Past Simple ile anlatılır.

questions.q: Which is the largest lake in Turkey?
questions.explain: Van Gölü Türkiye'nin en büyük gölüdür.

questions.q: Write a short paragraph introducing your city to a foreign visitor. Use at least two passive sentences.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: Ordu is a beautiful city on the Black Sea coast. It is known for its hazelnuts, which are grown all around the region. Boztepe can be reached by cable car and the whole city is seen from the top. Visitors are also offered delicious local food like pancar çorbası and hamsi.

questions.q: In football, players ___ touch the ball with their hands, except the goalkeeper.
questions.explain: Yasak anlatmak için "mustn't" kullanılır.

questions.q: In basketball, you ___ bounce the ball while you are moving.
questions.explain: Kural gereği zorunluluk "have to" ile anlatılır.

questions.q: Which sport is played with a racket and a shuttlecock?
questions.explain: Badmintonda raket ve tüylü top (shuttlecock) kullanılır.

questions.q: Wrestling is a traditional sport in Turkey, and oil wrestling ___ in Edirne every year.
questions.explain: Kırkpınar Yağlı Güreşleri her yıl Edirne'de düzenlenir; edilgen yapı kullanılır.

questions.q: You ___ wear a helmet when you ride a bike. It is not a rule, but it is a good idea.
questions.explain: Kural değil tavsiye olduğu için "should" uygundur.

questions.q: In tennis, you ___ wear special shoes, but it is better if you do.
questions.explain: "don't have to" zorunlu olmadığını, "mustn't" ise yasak olduğunu anlatır.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Swimming is good for your whole body.
Swim is good for your whole body.
Swimming are good for your whole body.
To swimming is good for your body.
Swims is good for your whole body.
questions.explain: Fiil özne olarak kullanılınca -ing alır (gerund) ve tekil sayılır.

questions.q: A friend ___ always tells the truth is very valuable.
questions.explain: İnsanları niteleyen sıfat cümlelerinde "who" kullanılır.

questions.q: This is the café ___ we first met.
questions.explain: Yer bildiren sıfat cümlelerinde "where" kullanılır.

questions.q: Elif is the girl ___ brother plays in the school band.
questions.explain: Sahiplik anlatan sıfat cümlelerinde "whose" kullanılır.

questions.q: Someone who is always ready to help others is ___.
questions.explain: Helpful yardımsever demektir.

questions.q: Someone who keeps their promises is ___.
questions.explain: Reliable güvenilir demektir.

questions.q: Can and Ali get on well ___ each other.
questions.explain: "get on well with" biriyle iyi anlaşmak demektir.

questions.q: Describe your best friend in a short paragraph. Use at least two relative clauses (who, which, where, whose).
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: My best friend is Zeynep, who has been in my class since primary school. She is a reliable and funny person who always makes me laugh. We often go to the library, where we study together. She has a cat whose name is Pamuk.

questions.q: You ___ wear a seatbelt in a car. It's the law.
questions.explain: Kural ve zorunluluk bildirirken "must" kullanılır.

questions.q: Write three rules for your school using must and mustn't.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: Students must arrive at school on time. We mustn't use our phones during lessons. We must respect our teachers and classmates.

questions.q: It is important ___ respect other people's opinions.
questions.explain: "It is important to + V1" kalıbı önemli olan davranışı anlatır.

questions.q: In Turkish culture, people usually take ___ their shoes before entering a home.
questions.explain: "take off" çıkarmak demektir.

questions.q: Which behaviour shows respect for elders in Turkey?
choices: Sitting while they stand on a bus
questions.explain: Bayramlarda büyüklerin elini öpmek Türk kültüründe saygı göstergesidir.

questions.q: You ___ talk loudly in a library.
questions.explain: Kütüphanede yüksek sesle konuşmak yasaktır; "mustn't" kullanılır.

questions.q: Honesty, kindness and responsibility are examples of ___.
questions.explain: Values değerler demektir.
